title: Village Friendship Guide
author: Kirpini OrangeVillager2
pages: Earning the loyalty and friendship of a village can be convincing. Thus, I created this guide to help you make friends with a village.
Firstly, a village’s opinion of you starts with an average opinion of all villagers in a village. This means trading with them and avoiding hurting them is a good first start.

Secondly, beds are a vital part for growing any village. Every villager needs a bed to sleep. Placing one gains opinion with the entire village but destroying one angers it. These beds do need to be inside though.
Finally, once you earn the friendship of a village, you can become its governor. The mayor can nominate you for the role and the bank has to approve. I’m sure you can get the bank’s support!
